channel.title: Clips
channel.description: Updates for Clips, clipboard history for Mac.

item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
• Clips is now a paid app for new users: $3.99 once, with a 30-day free trial. If you used Clips before this version, it stays free for you, forever. Thank you!
  • New: paperclip menu → License… shows your trial or license status.

item.title: Version 1.1.4
item.description:
• New: your clipboard history is now encrypted on your Mac (AES-256, key kept in your Keychain). Existing history is converted automatically.
  • New: API keys, tokens, HMAC secrets and private keys are detected and hidden (hold Option to show), marked with a key, and deleted after 24 hours unless you pin them. Filter them with Tab → Secrets Only.

item.title: Version 1.1.3
item.description:
• New: show only one type of item. Press Tab (or click "All Types" next to the search) to choose text, images, files, links, emails or colors.
  • Fixed: images copied from Finder now show as pictures and paste properly into chats, web pages and editors.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
• New: rename clipboard items. Select an item and press ⌘R (or right-click → Rename…) to give it a name like "My IBAN". Named items are pinned and you can search by their name.
  • New: right-click an item to Rename, Pin/Unpin or Delete it

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
• Fixed: screenshots pasted through Clips could look washed out (like a white overlay), especially on Macs with HDR displays. Clips now pastes images exactly as they were copied.
  • New: ⇧Return on an image pastes a standard version that looks the same in every app
  • More reliable keyboard focus when opening Clips right after switching apps

item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
• Automatic updates: Clips now keeps itself up to date
  • New "Check for Updates…" item in the menu bar menu
  • Version number shown in the menu
